lines.text: Twelve loaves of fine flour are set in two rows of six on the bronze altar.
Frankincense is placed near each row, and the bread is set out every Sabbath day on behalf of the foreigners.

problems.problem: Its true detail "table of pure gold" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
Its wrong detail "every new moon" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
"every new moon" and "Every Sabbath day" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).
